items.exampleEn: He broke his sister's toy out of spite.
items.exampleZh: 他出於惡意弄壞了他姊妹的玩具。
items.glossZh: 惡意（in spite of 儘管）

items.exampleEn: It is common courtesy to say thank you.
Opening a letter from an old friend still gives me a small thrill.
items.exampleZh: 打開老朋友寄來的信，仍讓我有點小興奮。

items.exampleEn: The new park was designed for relaxation, with benches and quiet paths.
items.exampleZh: 新公園是為休閒放鬆而設計的，有長椅和安靜的小徑。

items.exampleEn: There was a short hesitation before she answered the question.
items.exampleZh: 她回答問題前猶豫了一下。

items.exampleEn: To amuse ourselves on the long train ride, we played word games.
items.exampleZh: 為了在漫長的火車旅程中自娛，我們玩起了文字遊戲。

items.exampleEn: She talked enthusiastically about her new job at dinner.
items.exampleZh: 晚餐時，她熱切地談起她的新工作。

items.exampleEn: My old car is not fast, but it is very dependable.
items.exampleZh: 我的舊車不快，但非常可靠。

items.sentenceEn: In spite of the rain, the outdoor concert went on.
items.sentenceZh: 儘管下雨，戶外音樂會還是照常進行。

items.audioEn: Thanks for coming. As a courtesy, we offer every guest a free coffee.
items.audioZh: 謝謝光臨。我們禮貌性地招待每位客人一杯免費咖啡。

items.sentenceEn: Nothing beats the thrill of seeing snow for the first time.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有什麼比第一次看到雪更令人興奮了。

items.sentenceEn: The children cheered enthusiastically when the singer came on stage.
items.sentenceZh: 歌手一上台，孩子們就熱烈地歡呼。

items.stemEn: After a busy week, I need some ____, like a long bath and a good book.
items.stemZh: 忙碌了一週後，我需要一些放鬆，例如泡個長澡、看本好書。

items.stemEn: We need a ____ person who will always finish the work on time.
items.stemZh: 我們需要一位可靠、總能準時完成工作的人。

items.passageEn: When our team planned a weekend trip, everyone had different ideas. Kim wanted the thrill of mountain climbing, while Sam preferred pure relaxation at a hot spring. In the end, we agreed on a lake house where people could do both. Sam, the most dependable person in our office, booked everything as soon as the plan was decided. On the first night, Kim amused everyone with stories about her childhood. The owner of the lake house treated us with great courtesy and even brought us fresh fruit. When we got home, our manager enthusiastically suggested making the trip a yearly event, and the most sociable members agreed at once.
items.passageZh: 我們團隊規劃週末旅行時，每個人的想法都不一樣。Kim 想要登山的刺激，Sam 則比較想在溫泉純粹放鬆。最後，大家選了一間湖邊小屋，兩種活動都能做。Sam 是我們辦公室最可靠的人，計畫一確定，Sam 就把所有事情都訂好了。第一晚，Kim 講她小時候的故事，逗得大家很開心。湖邊小屋的主人待我們非常有禮，還送來新鮮水果。回家後，經理熱情地提議把這趟旅行變成每年的活動，幾個最愛交際的同事馬上贊成。

questions.questionZh: Kim 想要什麼樣的活動？

options: 下次全團改去國外旅行一週
把旅行變成每年的活動
下次換另一個人負責規劃

items.promptZh: 她毫不猶豫地答應幫忙。
referenceEn: She agreed to help without hesitation.
Without any hesitation, she agreed to help.
rubricZh: hesitation 的用法，例如 without hesitation、without any hesitation 等
「答應」可寫，例如 agree、say yes 等

items.promptZh: 我爺爺的老笑話總是能逗我們開心。
referenceEn: My grandfather's old jokes always amuse us.
We are always amused by my grandpa's old jokes.
rubricZh: amuse 表示「逗樂、使開心」（例如 amuse us、be amused by 等）
always 位置不扣分；主詞是 jokes 時動詞不加 s
